body: Emotional life runs deep and sits close to the unconscious; you feel intensely and stay unusually in touch with what most people bury. Feelings can surface with a force others don't carry, and little stays buried for long.
business: Emotionally perceptive and resilient; reads the undercurrent in a room.
shadow: Emotional volatility, and old feelings that come up raw and large until they're given room.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
